recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, cinematic photograph of a young couple dancing back-to-back in a crowded, dimly lit venue, overlaid with a vibrant purple neon script title and clean sans-serif metadata.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon title acts as a physical barrier/bridge across the central subjects
Warm, golden bokeh background contrasts with the cool purple neon glow
Dynamic body language of subjects creates a sense of rhythmic motion
High-contrast lighting emphasizes the textures of clothing and skin
coreInvariants: Purple neon glow effect on the main script
Central placement of the dancing couple
Top-aligned secondary text in all-caps sans-serif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupy the middle ground, scaled to fill the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing neon script title positioned across the lower-middle third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, follow the subjects' arms down to the neon title, then circulate through the background crowd.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures and light artifacts to simulate a crowded party.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and gold tones in the background and skin highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant electric purple/violet for the neon title and its surrounding glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon element against a desaturated, high-contrast photographic background.

letterConstructionRules: Continuous stroke mimicking bent neon tubing
Consistent stroke weight throughout the script
Slight upward slant from left to right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal tails on the first and last letters to frame the composition

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in the dark upper margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, organic neon script with a rigid, geometric architectural sans-serif.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for top text

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the physical properties of neon signage.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked metadata at the top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic photo of a young man and woman dancing back-to-back in a crowded bar. The lighting is warm with heavy golden bokeh in the background. High contrast, film grain, and slight motion blur on the peripheral dancers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a purple neon script style with a white inner core and a soft violet outer glow. Add a single line of all-caps, wide-tracked white sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Neon script has a distinct white core and purple outer glow.
Top text is perfectly centered and widely tracked.
Background subjects are out of focus compared to the central pair.
The neon title overlaps the subjects without obscuring their faces.

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Does the neon script feel integrated into the 3D space of the image?
Is the top text legible against the dark background?
Is the grain and texture consistent across the photograph?
Does the composition feel energetic and 'alive'?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-action social photography base with a 'neon-sign' graphic overlay and 'architectural-sans' metadata for a modern-retro cinematic look.
